description: Source code for MAX7219 LED display driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing display control via SPI with cascading support.

methods.name: max7219_transmit_all
methods.description: Transmits a specific register address and value to all cascaded MAX7219 devices via SPI.

methods.name: max7219_transmit_one
methods.description: Transmits a register address and value to a specific MAX7219 device in the cascade.

methods.name: next_pixel
methods.description: Retrieves the next pixel bit from the buffer, updating mask and data accordingly.

methods.name: skip_pixel
methods.description: Skips a number of pixels in the buffer.

methods.name: max7219_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the display buffer and updates the hardware.

methods.name: max7219_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the display by transmitting the intensity value.

methods.name: max7219_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format; only supports monochrome 01 format.

methods.name: max7219_set_orientation
methods.description: Sets the display orientation; only supports normal orientation.

methods.name: max7219_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and supported formats.

methods.name: max7219_init
methods.description: Initializes the MAX7219 device, configures registers, and prepares display buffer.
